title: Checking the function of the GPS antenna
body_md:
To check whether GPS data are being received, set the operating mode switch to the diagnosis position. The status LED then indicates the state of GPS reception:

| Indication | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| lights up red | GPS not connected |
| flashes yellow | GPS data are received, but without a valid position. If it is still flashing after five minutes, the antenna is mounted where GPS reception is impossible, or the vehicle is under a roof. |
| lights up green | The installation position of the GPS antenna is OK. |

Set the switch back to the starting position afterwards. If the indicator then lights up red, no SIM card has been inserted yet.
